newsitem.title: GREECE: U.S EMBASSY CLOSED ON COLOMBUS DAY, OCT 14.
newsitem.headline: U.S EMBASSY CLOSED ON COLOMBUS DAY, OCT 14.

text.p: The U.S embassy in Athens, the U.S consulates in Athens and Thessaloniki and all U.S government officies in Greece, except for the American Library, will be closed on Monday, October 14 in obervance of Colombus day, it said in a statement.
Colombus day is a U.S national holiday. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
